第一百三十九章伏击
第十二天，小队按计划向第六处节点进发。这处节点位于磐石城正西方向约一百五十里处，藏在一座废弃的烽燧台下方的地窖中。按照石头的地脉判断和陆尘的天眼验证，这处节点虽然规模不大，但位置关键——它连接着两条地脉支流，是邪修防线上一个重要的能量中转枢纽。
拔掉它，邪修在磐石城西侧的能量供应将出现一段明显的空白期。
一路上都很顺利。斥候在前方探路，没有发现任何异常；老兵们保持着标准的战斗队形，警惕地注视着四周；石头跟在陆尘身后，沉默地走着，偶尔蹲下身抓起一把泥土闻一闻，然后点点头，继续赶路。一切看起来都和之前五次行动一样，平静、顺利、毫无波澜。
但他们没有注意到的是，从他们离开上一个休整点开始，就有一双眼睛在远处的山脊上，一直注视着他们的动向。那双眼睛的主人没有靠近，没有发出任何声响，如同一块沉默的岩石，融入了山体的阴影之中。直到确认小队的方向确实是那座废弃烽燧台后，那双眼睛才缓缓隐去，如同一滴水融入了大海。
当陆尘带着小队抵达烽燧台外围时，天色已经暗了下来。斥候照例先行潜入侦察，但这一次，他去了比预想中更长的时间。陆尘蹲在一块岩石后面，看着斥候消失的方向，心中那股隐隐的不安感越来越强烈。他看了一眼身旁的苏清禾，苏清禾也微微蹙着眉，握剑的手指比平时更紧了一些。
“不对。”苏清禾低声说，“太安静了。”
陆尘也感觉到了。前五处节点，外围或多或少都有一些邪修活动的痕迹——脚印、篝火灰烬、残留的食物残渣。但这座烽燧台周围，干净得像是被刻意打扫过一样，连一根折断的树枝都找不到。这种刻意的整洁，反而比明显的防备更加可疑。
他正要下令撤退，异变陡生。
烽燧台四周的地面忽然塌陷了数个大坑，坑中涌出浓密的黑烟，黑烟中夹杂着刺鼻的硫磺味和尖锐的破空声。数十支骨箭从黑烟中射出，如同暴雨般覆盖了小队的藏身区域。两名老兵躲闪不及，被骨箭射穿了小腿和大腿，闷哼着倒下。斥候从烽燧台的方向踉跄着跑回来，肩膀上插着一支骨箭，脸色苍白，嘴唇哆嗦着说出一句话：“有埋伏……至少三十人……他们知道我们要来……”
陆尘的大脑在那一瞬间仿佛被冰水浇透了一般，骤然清醒。他们被算计了。邪修不是没有发现他们的破坏行动，而是一直在等——等他们形成固定的行动模式，等他们放松警惕，然后选择一处他们必然会来的节点，布下陷阱，一网打尽。
“撤！”他吼道，“往东边林地撤！不要恋战！”
老兵们搀扶着受伤的同伴，开始向林地方向撤退。石头紧跟在他身后，脸色发白，但没有慌乱。苏清禾断后，剑光在黑暗中划出一道道冷冽的弧线，将几枚追踪而来的骨箭劈落在地。但邪修的伏兵显然做了充分的准备——他们不仅在地面上布置了陷阱，还在林地边缘预设了第二道封锁线。当小队撤到林地边缘时，又有十几名邪修从树影中冲出，截断了他们的退路。
苏清禾没有犹豫。她转身迎向那十几名邪修，剑势如狂风扫叶，一瞬间便斩倒了三人。但邪修的人数太多了，而且他们的目标显然不是杀死所有人——他们分出大部分人缠住苏清禾，剩下的人则绕过她，向陆尘和石头扑去。陆尘掷出两枚蚀灵锥，放倒了一名冲在最前面的邪修，但更多的邪修已经涌了上来。就在他准备引爆最后一枚高纯源晶拼死一搏时，一道黑影从侧面掠出，挡在了他面前。
是苏清禾。她不知何时摆脱了缠斗，飞身掠到他身前，一剑将那名扑向他的邪修斩退。但就在她出剑的瞬间，地面下忽然探出数根暗红色的骨刺，如同活物般缠绕住了她的脚踝和小腿。那是邪修预先埋设在地下的陷阱——骨刺上刻满了扭曲的符文，一旦被缠住，便会不断吸取被困者的源能和体力。苏清禾挥剑斩断了两根骨刺，但更多的骨刺已经从地下涌出，如同毒蛇般沿着她的腿部向上攀爬，将她牢牢束缚在原地。
一名身穿暗红色斗篷的邪修老者，从烽燧台的阴影中缓缓走出。他的手中握着一柄扭曲的骨杖，杖头镶嵌着一枚暗红色的晶石，晶石的光芒与那些骨刺上的符文遥相呼应。他走到苏清禾面前，低头看着她，用一种仿佛砂纸摩擦般的沙哑声音说道：“天衍宗的弟子……正好。主人的祭坛，正缺一份像样的祭品。”
他挥了挥手，骨刺中分出数根细小的分支，如同活物般缠绕住了苏清禾的手腕和脖颈，将她整个人提离了地面。苏清禾咬紧牙关，没有发出任何声音，只是用那双依然清澈的眼睛，看了陆尘一眼。那一眼中没有恐惧，没有责备，只有平静而坚定的东西——像是在说，不要管我，走。
陆尘的瞳孔骤然收缩。他看到苏清禾被骨刺缠绕着拖向烽燧台的方向，看到那名邪修老者转身离去时袍角扬起的弧度，看到周围的邪修正向他围拢过来，手中的武器在月光下泛着寒光。他的大脑在那一瞬间变得异常清醒——清醒到他能清晰地计算出自己与苏清禾之间的距离，清醒到他能判断出自己不可能在这么多邪修的包围下将她救出来，清醒到他意识到，如果他此刻冲上去，不仅救不了她，还会把自己和剩下的队员都搭进去。
他做出了一个极其痛苦的决定。
“撤！”他的声音嘶哑，几乎是从喉咙深处挤出来的，“所有人，往东撤！不准回头！”

石头拉着他的胳膊，将他拖向林地的方向。老兵们搀扶着伤员，跟在他们身后，向黑暗中撤退。邪修追了一段，但没有穷追不舍——他们的主要目标已经达成了。
陆尘在奔跑中回过头，最后看了一眼烽燧台的方向。他看到苏清禾被骨刺缠绕着的身影，正在被拖入烽燧台下方的地窖入口。那枚暗红色的晶石在地窖入口处闪烁着不祥的光芒，如同某种远古巨兽缓缓合拢的嘴巴，将她吞没在黑暗之中。
他转回头，咬着牙，继续向黑暗中奔跑。夜风在耳边呼啸，带着血腥味和泥土的气息。他的脑海中反复回响着一个声音——必须把她救出来。无论付出什么代价。

Chapter 139 Ambush
On the twelfth day, the team headed to the sixth node as planned. This node is located about one hundred and fifty miles due west of Panshi City, hidden in a cellar under an abandoned beacon tower. According to Stone's earth vein judgment and Lu Chen's heavenly eye verification, although this node is not large in scale, its location is critical - it connects two earth vein tributaries and is an important energy transfer hub on the evil defense line.
If you unplug it, there will be an obvious blank period in the energy supply of the evil cultivator on the west side of Rock City.
It was smooth sailing all the way. The scouts explored the road ahead and found nothing unusual; the veterans maintained a standard battle formation and watched the surroundings vigilantly; Shitou followed Lu Chen, walking silently, occasionally squatting down to grab a handful of dirt and smell it, then nodded and continued on his way. Everything looked the same as the previous five operations, calm, smooth, and without any ripples.
But what they didn't notice was that there was a pair of eyes on the distant ridge that had been watching their movements since they left the last rest point. The owner of those eyes did not come close, and did not make any sound. He was like a silent rock, blending into the shadow of the mountain. It wasn't until it was confirmed that the direction of the team was indeed the abandoned beacon tower that the eyes slowly disappeared, like a drop of water merging into the sea.
When Lu Chen led the team to the outskirts of the beacon tower, the sky was already dark. The scout sneaked in for reconnaissance as usual, but this time, he went longer than expected. Lu Chen squatted behind a rock and looked at the direction in which the scout disappeared, feeling a faint sense of uneasiness in his heart getting stronger and stronger. He glanced at Su Qinghe beside him. Su Qinghe also frowned slightly, and his fingers holding the sword were tighter than usual.
"No." Su Qinghe whispered, "It's too quiet."
Chase Lu also felt it. The first five nodes and the periphery have more or less traces of evil cultivators' activities - footprints, campfire ashes, and remaining food residues. But the area around this beacon tower was as clean as if it had been cleaned deliberately. Not even a broken branch could be found. This deliberate neatness is more suspicious than the obvious precautions.
Just as he was about to order a retreat, a sudden change occurred.
The ground around the beacon tower suddenly collapsed into several large pits, and thick black smoke poured out of the pits. The black smoke was mixed with the pungent smell of sulfur and the sharp sound of breaking through the air. Dozens of bone arrows shot out of the black smoke, covering the team's hiding area like a heavy rain. The two veterans were unable to dodge, and were shot through their calves and thighs by bone arrows, and fell down with a groan. The scout staggered back from the direction of the beacon tower, with a bone arrow stuck in his shoulder. His face was pale, and his lips were trembling as he said: "There is an ambush... at least thirty people... they know we are coming..."
Lu Chen's brain seemed to be doused with ice water at that moment, and he suddenly woke up. They were plotted. It’s not that the evil cultivators didn’t notice their destructive actions, but they have been waiting for them to form a fixed pattern of action, wait for them to relax their vigilance, and then choose a node where they are bound to come, lay a trap, and catch them all.
"Retreat!" he shouted, "Retreat to the east woodland! Don't be reluctant to fight!"
The veterans supported their injured companions and began to retreat toward the forest. Shitou followed closely behind him, his face pale but not panicked. After Su Qinghe broke, the sword light drew cold arcs in the darkness, knocking down several bone arrows that were following him to the ground. But the evil cultivator's ambush was obviously fully prepared - they not only set up traps on the ground, but also set up a second blockade on the edge of the forest. When the team retreated to the edge of the forest, more than a dozen evil cultivators rushed out from the shadows of the trees, cutting off their retreat.
Su Qinghe did not hesitate. She turned around to face the dozen evil cultivators, her sword was like a strong wind sweeping leaves, and she chopped down three of them in an instant. But there are too many evil cultivators, and their goals are obvious.Of course, instead of killing everyone - they separated most of them to entangle Su Qinghe, while the rest walked around her and rushed towards Lu Chen and Shitou. Lu Chen threw two soul-eating cones and knocked down an evil cultivator who rushed to the front, but more evil cultivators had already surged up. Just when he was about to detonate the last high-purity source crystal in a desperate attempt, a black shadow swept out from the side and blocked him.
It's Su Qinghe. She didn't know when to get rid of the fight, flew in front of him, and drove away the evil cultivator who rushed towards him with one sword. But the moment she drew her sword, several dark red bone spurs suddenly appeared from the ground, wrapping around her ankles and calves like living creatures. It was a trap laid underground by evil cultivators in advance - the bone spurs were engraved with twisted runes. Once entangled, they would continuously absorb the source energy and physical strength of the trapped person. Su Qinghe cut off two bone spurs with a sword, but more bone spurs had emerged from the ground, climbing up her legs like poisonous snakes, tightly binding her in place.
An old evil cultivator wearing a dark red cloak slowly walked out of the shadow of the beacon tower. He held a twisted bone staff in his hand. The head of the staff was inlaid with a dark red crystal. The light of the crystal echoed the runes on the bone spurs. He walked up to Su Qinghe, looked down at her, and said in a hoarse voice like sandpaper: "The disciples of Tianyan Sect... are just right. The master's altar is missing a decent sacrifice."
He waved his hand, and several small branches separated from the bone spurs, wrapping around Su Qinghe's wrists and neck like living creatures, lifting her whole body off the ground. Su Qinghe gritted his teeth and didn't make any sound. He just glanced at Lu Chen with his still clear eyes. There was no fear, no reproach in that look, just something calm and firm - as if to say, leave me alone and go.
Lu Chen's pupils suddenly shrank. He saw Su Qinghe being entangled with bone spurs and being dragged towards the beacon tower, saw the arc of the corners of the robe raised when the evil cultivator turned around and left, and saw the evil cultivators surrounding him closing in on him, the weapons in their hands glowing coldly under the moonlight. His brain became extremely clear at that moment - so clear that he could clearly calculate the distance between himself and Su Qinghe, so clear that he could judge that he could not rescue her surrounded by so many evil cultivators, so clear that he realized that if he rushed forward at this moment, not only would he not be able to save her, he would also get himself and the remaining team members involved.
He made an extremely painful decision.
"Evacuate!" His voice was hoarse, almost squeezed out from the depths of his throat, "Everyone, retreat eastward! Don't look back!"
The stone grabbed his arm and dragged him in the direction of the woodland. The veterans supported the wounded and followed them as they retreated into the darkness. The evil cultivators chased for a while, but they did not pursue him relentlessly - their main goal had been achieved.
Lu Chen turned around while running and took one last look in the direction of the beacon tower. He saw Su Qinghe's figure entangled with bone spurs being dragged into the cellar entrance below the beacon tower. The dark red spar shone ominously at the entrance to the cellar, like the mouth of some ancient behemoth that slowly closed, swallowing her up in the darkness.
He turned back, gritted his teeth, and continued running into the darkness. The night wind whistled in my ears, carrying the smell of blood and earth. A voice echoed repeatedly in his mind - she must be rescued. No matter what the cost.
